articles.summary: New agentic AI integration will give learners and educators access to trusted McGraw Hill content through UCSF’s generative AI tool to power precision learning experiences Key Highlights: McGraw Hill is collaborating with the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) School of Medicine to integrate its trusted medical content into their institution-developed generative AI platform. Using a Model Context Protocol (MCP) connection, UCSF’s AI tutor can access McGraw Hill content, including Harrison’s Principles of Internal Medicine , to provide clinicians and medical students personalized support and precision learning experiences. McGraw Hill’s AI strategy extends the company’s reach to new channels and platforms that educators and learners are using, driving its growth and expanding the market for its proprietary content and expertise. The collaboration will help McGraw Hill and UCSF evaluate how students use agentic AI experiences to learn and their potential to support
articles.title: McGraw Hill Integrates Trusted Content into AI Platform Developed by University of California, San Francisco School of Medicine
